title: Animals
description: Pets, farm animals and wild animals.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the cat”
items.explain: Le chat dort sur le canapé. — The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the horse”
items.explain: Elle monte à cheval. — She rides a horse.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the pig”
items.explain: Le cochon est rose. — The pig is pink.

items.prompt: What does “le mouton” mean?
items.explain: Les moutons sont dans le pré. — The sheep are in the meadow.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the duck”
items.explain: Le canard nage sur le lac. — The duck is swimming on the lake.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the rabbit”
items.explain: Le lapin mange une carotte. — The rabbit is eating a carrot.

items.exampleEn: The cat is chasing the mouse.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the bird”
items.explain: L'oiseau chante le matin. — The bird sings in the morning.

items.prompt: What does “le poisson” mean?
items.explain: J'ai un poisson rouge. — I have a goldfish.

items.exampleFr: Le lion est le roi des animaux.
items.exampleEn: The lion is the king of the animals.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the elephant”
items.explain: L'éléphant est énorme. — The elephant is enormous.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the monkey”
items.explain: Le singe grimpe dans l'arbre. — The monkey climbs the tree.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the wolf”
items.explain: Le loup vit dans la forêt. — The wolf lives in the forest.

items.prompt: What does “le renard” mean?
items.explain: Le renard est rusé. — The fox is cunning.

items.exampleEn: The frog jumps into the water.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the snake”
items.explain: J'ai peur des serpents. — I am afraid of snakes.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the bee”
items.explain: L'abeille fait du miel. — The bee makes honey.

items.exampleFr: Un papillon vole dans le jardin.
items.exampleEn: A butterfly is flying in the garden.

items.prompt: In French, with the article: “the tortoise / turtle”
items.explain: La tortue marche lentement. — The tortoise walks slowly.

items.prompt: What does “l'animal de compagnie” mean?
items.explain: Tu as un animal de compagnie ? — Do you have a pet?

items.prompt: Un cheval, deux ___.
Un animal, des ___.
Un oiseau, des ___.
Which animal says “miaou”?
Which animal gives milk?
